```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

if (params$input_name != "UNKNOWN") {
  description <- params$input_name
} else if (!is.null(names(params$event_col)[[1]])) {
  description <- names(params$event_col)[[1]]
} else {
  description <- params$event_col[[1]]
}
```


```{r run-analysis}
gec_result <- driveanalytics::gen_event_count(params$df, params$df_pde, params$event_col, params$cohort_col)
```
